blocks.html: Robinsons Land’s ArtAblado recently concluded its year-ender offering, the ChristmaSAYA Christmas Card Competition which was opened to children aged 6 to 12 years. This year’s Christmas Card Making art completion garnered 60 entries, each depicting their personal experience of Christmas amidst the pandemic. “Each entry shows the child’s memories of Christmas spent in Robinsons Malls, pre-pandemic and how they cherish this wonderful memory,” says Roseann C. Villegas, director for Corporate PR, Robinsons Land.
Every entry has a story to tell. Each child shared his/her unforgettable memories at Robinsons Malls.
Six (6) finalists emerged from the selection where the top three (3) winners were selected from each category.

The official winners for each division: 1st Place, Season of Joy and Sharing by Franzel Eunice Yaneza and Glee and Grace in Robinsons by Ayanna Emry Manuel – both will receive Php15,000.00 and certificate; 2nd Place, Simpleng Hiling by Jose Inigo Diokno and Snow Globe of Hope by Hailey Yzabel Aldea – each will receive Php10,000.00 and a certificate, and; 3rd Place – Liwanag ng Pasko byAlkisar Macapundag and Makulay na Pasko by Sanz Khyle Salonga – will each bring home Php5,000.00 and a certificate. Finalists will also receive a certificate and Php2,000.00 cash prize.
To see the complete list of Robinsons Land ARTablado finalists and their entries, visit the official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/ARTablado/ and @Artablado at Instagram.
